title: Would You Rather?
tags: would you rather,choices,questions,party game,friends,family,talking,silly,this or that,no wrong answers
description: Would you rather talk to animals or fly like a bird? Pick one of two over 400 times, with no right or wrong answers! Play alone to find out what kind of chooser you are, pass the tablet round with up to 6 friends and see who picks alike, or guess what your friend picked.
notes: Official rebuild of the member game of the same idea (which was hard to play on a tablet). Built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.1 (pinned kit tag plus the dress pack): a meadow stage behind DOM cards. Nothing is scored, since there are no right answers: no points, no leaderboard, no BRB.score. A finished run (the end card, after at least one pick) signals BRB.gameOver({ won: true }) exactly once with no score, so a course step that assigns a run completes only when the run is actually played to its end; opening the game completes nothing. Modes: Play alone (10, 20 or endless; ends with a kind 'You're a…' card from the tags on the options picked), With friends (2-6 players pass one device, everyone picks in secret, then the picks are revealed side by side; the end shows the most alike pair and everyone's own type), and Guess my pick (one picks in secret, the rest put their face on the card they think; shows how many guessed right). 444 dilemmas in 13 topics (animals, food, superpowers, school, adventure, silly, sports, nature and space, future, friends and family, big thinkers, tech choices, online: share or keep); every option is 60 characters or less and has tags from 12 kind traits. Cards stack in portrait and sit side by side in landscape. Questions are not repeated until a topic's pool is used up (seen ids in BRB.storage 'would-you-rather-v1'). Source: scripts/data/would-you-rather (en.json questions, ui.json words in 13 languages); scripts/wyr-bank.js builds them into the page, and a translated <lang>.json becomes a language pack under public/vendor/data/would-you-rather.
